signal: Centrical raised a $39M Series D in June 2026 to expand globally and shipped agentic AI innovations for frontline teams

email.body1:
Julian, saw Centrical closed its $39M Series D to fuel global expansion.

Scaling a partner motion that fast usually means more co-sell and partner-sourced accounts than the team can cover by hand, and good opportunities go cold before anyone activates them. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously across the partner ecosystem, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Centrical's partner ecosystem off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Julian, quick follow-up for Centrical.

Post-raise, partner-sourced pipeline targets usually climb faster than the team can activate co-sell motions by hand. Most orgs don't actually know how much coverage their partner ecosystem needs to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through a co-sell pilot playbook and our pipeline model, showing exactly how many partner meetings Centrical needs this quarter and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Julian, last bit of proof for Centrical.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Centrical's partner reply rate likely compares to other scaling SaaS firms. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Julian, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and I know standing up global expansion is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a co-sell motion? I will tailor it to Centrical's ecosystem either way.
